title: My 2D Auto & Roguelike Cat vs Zombie Defense
author: jozune
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been building Night Paws – Zombie Siege on my own for a while now. It's my first ever mobile game.  
  
The gameplay is simple: three cats hold the lane behind sandbags while zombies walk toward them. The cats shoot on their own (auto mode and x2 mode), and you choose the skills, traps and upgrades.

What's in the video:

* Boss fights with telegraphed attacks
* Roguelike ability, pick 1 of 3 cards after each wave
* A squad of cats, each with their own gun
* Supply bags and recruit packs to open
* Skill tree and lab upgrades
* 3 minigames between levels, including fishing

Made with Claude (x20 Max Plan, over a month), Phaser 3 + TypeScript. Most of the art was made with ChatGPT Plus for generating assets.

Would love to hear your first impressions! Does the damage between cats and zombies feel balanced? How do the rarity rates feel? I know the minigame is quite easy, but it's meant as a short break between levels.

The demo is playable in your browser, no account, no install: [**nightpaws.vinclair.cloud**](http://nightpaws.vinclair.cloud)  
Code **STAMPCAT2026** gives you Stamp, a mail-carrier cat with a slingshot.

Discord: [https://discord.gg/ghPSBSWTY](https://discord.gg/ghPSBSWTY)

Thanks for watching.
